toplevel: @State initializers: reanalyzeFromDate = now minus 2 weeks (?? now), reanalyzeToDate = now, evaluated when the view value is created. reanalyzeTask is not cancelled when the page is dismissed, so a running reanalysis continues in the background.

Starts reanalysis: resets progress, computes from = start of From day and to = To date (ReanalysisService extends it to 23:59:59) when range on, stores a Task that awaits RRCollector.reanalyzeAllSessions with a progress callback, checks Task.isCancelled for Stop, then finishReanalysis on main.
calls: closure:progress callback → Emuqu/Sources/Views/SettingsPages+Diagnostics.swift:469 set here, invoked by ReanalysisService.reanalyzeAllSessions

flags.text: reanalyzeTask is never cancelled when the page is dismissed (no onDisappear) and isReanalyzing is per-view @State, so after leaving and re-entering Troubleshooting the user can start a second reanalysis over the same sessions while the first keeps running (ReanalysisService has no concurrency guard), and the first run's completion alert is delivered to a discarded view. repairTrainingSnapshots (:512) has the same shape.

branches.effect: "Reanalyzed N sessions. M with manual windows preserved."; else "Reanalyzed N sessions with updated scoring."

flags.text: Sessions whose reanalysis returns nil are counted in neither `updated` nor `skipped`, and the alert ("Reanalyzed N sessions with updated scoring.") never mentions them, so failed sessions keep their old scores silently.

units.does: Runs SessionArchive.repairArchive off-main (Task.detached) — deletes *.encrypted files in the archive dir, rebuilds and saves index.json — then shows "Removed corrupted files and rebuilt the index. Sessions recovered: N".

flags.text: "Sessions recovered: N" reports index.count after the rebuild (every session in the archive), not the number recovered.
Same repair as ArchiveDiagnosticsView.performRepair, which is behind a confirmation dialog and refreshes diagnostics afterwards; this copy runs a file-deleting repair with no confirmation.
